title: Insider data exfiltration: Northwind Analytics workstation WKS-FIN-07 (SYNTHETIC)
description: Fictional scenario. An employee who has given notice stages customer pricing, a roadmap and a client list, archives them with 7-Zip, renames the archive to look like a holiday photo, copies it to a USB drive, deletes the original archive and two notes, runs a secure-delete tool, and sets back the dates on a staged document.
